title: Cannot connect to Corporate VPN
description: Getting error 800 when attempting to connect to corporate gateway from home.
query: Cannot connect to Corporate VPN: Getting error 800 when attempting to connect to corporate gateway from home.
aiSummary: VPN gateway connection error 800 during remote session.
ai_response: Checking network protocols and adapter settings. An IT agent is assigned.

messages.message: Hello, I am unable to connect to the VPN gateway today.
Hi Alex, let me check the gateway tunnel certificates. One moment.

title: How do I reset my account password?
description: Forgot my login password and need to regain access to my dashboard.
query: How do I reset my account password?: Forgot my login password and need to regain access to my dashboard.
ai_response: Click on the Forgot Password option on the login page. Enter your registered email address and follow the password reset instructions sent to your email.

title: Billing address update for monthly enterprise subscription
description: Our headquarters moved to a new facility. Please update our invoice tax address.
query: Billing address update: Please update invoice address to new facility.
aiSummary: Corporate tax and invoice address change request.
ai_response: Go to Account Settings, open Billing Information, update your billing address, and save the changes.

title: API Rate Limit exceeded during batch webhook sync
description: Receiving HTTP 429 response during hourly analytics payload transmission.
query: API Rate Limit exceeded: HTTP 429 received during hourly export.
aiSummary: Webhook pipeline encountering HTTP 429 rate limit errors.
ai_response: API rate limits depend on your subscription tier. High throughput endpoints require rate-limit smoothing.

title: Enable Two-Factor Authentication for department accounts
description: How do team members enable TOTP / Authenticator app for enhanced security?
query: Enable Two-Factor Authentication: How do users enable 2FA?
aiSummary: Request for two-factor authentication configuration instructions.
ai_response: ZenFlow supports two-factor authentication. Users can enable 2FA directly from Security Settings for additional account protection.
